scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @signal-audit/web dev
scripts.dev:worker: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm --filter @signal-audit/worker dev
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm run build:packages && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:unit && corepack pnpm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: corepack pnpm run build:packages && node --test tests/integration/worker.test.ts
scripts.test:ts: corepack pnpm run test:architecture && corepack pnpm run test:integration
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.cjs apps packages && node tests/architecture/check-workspace-boundaries.mjs && corepack pnpm run test:architecture
scripts.check: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm check:architecture && corepack pnpm build
